title: The People of the Galilee
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: They are mentioned in Gittin 60a, where they sent to Rabbi Chelbo asking whether it is permitted to read from separate books of the Pentateuch publicly in the synagogue. The people of the Galilee and the people of Judea are likewise mentioned in Eruvin 53a: the people of the Galilee were not careful with their speech, etc., and the people of Judea were careful with their speech, etc.
